questions: Is a route the same in both directions? For example, if you add Circle to Madina, should a passenger searching Madina to Circle get the same fare, or do you add each direction separately?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, using a password or login, while passengers can only look fares up?
If there is no direct route between two stops, should passengers be told there is no route, or should the system suggest changing trotros and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
